#ClimateEmergency means our lives and our kids’ lives are at risk. What could be a more urgent policy imperative? Finally a major party, with @AlboMP leading, is saying it. 2050 is 20 years out from @UKLabour pledge. How is that radical? Wake up #auspol 
https://t.co/eco9BeRE0y

Thanks to @BalliolOxford for an excellent #IWD alum event tonight in London to celebrate 40 years of #balliolwomen (yes, that recent since we were allowed in). Great to hear from Aussie scholar Alice Evatt on #climate ethics and action. Read about her work https://t.co/ysRhKOx3np

Delighted that the brilliant @RRegenvanu has been re-elected in #Vanuatu. His work for communities at home in Vanuatu is inspiring, as is his #climate advocacy & commitment to supporting Melanesian culture & solidarity. Look forward to continuing our work on #WestPapua #wantok https://t.co/ZIT0wn9eej
